parameters.message:
Hello Glenn,

All the Products have been posted. If you want to post existing products change the status to pending in TheScottishCurse sheet.

To post existing products:
The product that you want to post select that product, and charge the status column to pending.

To Add new products:
Add new 
product Name, 
Product Description,
Image Link (upload the image in Drive and copy the link),
Status (copy the previous column and past it, and change the status to pending).

Image Folder Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1mO_J_JIY0A0CjW4uXDhwqU60WsyThrEf?usp=drive_link

Google Sheet Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JpASAvT7NsGtBGhuFw3uv-K6yKq4zfEf1vIaFmjxKtk/edit?usp=sharing

Thank You.
